BT21-071.effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 card with the [Appmon] or [Three Musketeers] trait from your hand or trash as 1 of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card, gain 1 memory.
[Special Rule] +3000 DP
BT21-071.xros_req: [Special Digivolution Condition] [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Three Musketeers] in text: Cost 2
BT21-071.link_effect_description_eng: [When Linking] ＜Draw 2＞ and trash 2 cards in your hand.

BT21-074.effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 [Appmon] or [Three Musketeers] trait card from your hand or trash as any of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card, until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't return that Digimon to hands or decks or affect it with ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 card with the [Appmon] or [Three Musketeers] trait from your Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[Special Rule] +4000 DP
BT21-074.xros_req: [Special Digivolution Condition] [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Three Musketeers] in text: Cost 3
BT21-074.link_effect_description_eng: [When Linking] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.

EX12-076.effect_description_eng:
＜Rush＞ ＜Raid＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Hybrid] Form.
EX12-076.xros_req:
[Special Digivolution Condition] [Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[Hybrid]/[Shambala]/[TS] trait: Cost 5
[Special Play Condition] Assembly -9: 8 [Hybrid]/[Shambala] trait cards w/different names

BT26-033.effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ ＜Alliance＞ ＜Engage＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack.)
[When Digivolving] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, if it's your turn, you may play or use 1 [Iliad] or [TS] trait card from your hand with the cost reduced by 5.
[All Turns] When any of your [TS] trait Digimon or Tamers would leave the battle area, by placing this Digimon's top stacked card as the bottom security card, they don't leave.
